item.title: Supreme Court blocks law against schools outing transgender students to their parents in California
item.description: Religious parents and educators challenged California policies aimed at preventing schools from outing children.

item.title: ‘Heart sank’: Mom speaks at sentencing of Woodbury day-care worker who broke 9-month-old’s leg
item.description: The Wisconsin woman's attorney argued for electronic monitoring instead of jail, saying she was remorseful and had impaired intellectual abilities.

item.title: Iranians in the Twin Cities watch, hope and wonder — what’s next?
item.description: "I didn't want the war to start, but now that it's started ... the best outcome of the war would be to have a regime change," said Parham Alaei, a professor.

item.title: In a first as president, Trump says he’ll attend the White House correspondents’ dinner
item.description: Trump skipped the dinner throughout his first term and also missed last year’s event.

item.title: Jalisco cartel leader ‘El Mencho’ buried in a golden casket in a Guadalajara cemetery
item.description: A federal official confirmed that Nemesio Oseguera Cervantes, alias “El Mencho,” was buried in a cemetery in Zapopan, a suburb of Guadalajara, Mexico’s second-largest city.

item.title: Democrats’ newfound unity faces a test after US and Israeli strikes on Iran
item.description: Some pro-Israel Democrats say they will not support a war powers vote to limit Trump.

item.title: Rubio says ‘hardest hits are yet to come’ as Trump predicts weeks of war
item.description: The secretary of state said the United States would strike Iran until it had achieved its objectives, including the destruction of Iran’s ballistic missile capabilities.

item.title: U.S. Embassy in Saudi capital hit by 2 drones on Tuesday, kingdom says
item.description: The ministry said there was “limited fire and minor material damage to the building.”

item.title: Washington County warns residents that scammers are impersonating county staff
item.description: Washington County is warning people about a phishing scam involving a domain pretending to be an official government one.

item.title: US Embassy in Saudi Arabia hit with Iranian drones as American and Israeli attacks on Iran escalate
item.description: The U.S. State Department urged U.S. citizens to leave more than a dozen Middle Eastern countries, as have many other countries, though with much of the airspace closed many remain stranded.
